title: Sharpness-aware Muon on digits MLP
setting: A 64-64-10 ReLU MLP is trained on a subsample of sklearn load_digits with a fixed 150-step budget, using Muon-style Newton-Schulz orthogonalized momentum updates for weight matrices and momentum SGD for biases. Methods differ only in how the gradient used for the update is obtained: at the current point (Muon), at a point perturbed along the normalized clean minibatch gradient (MuSAM, two gradient evaluations), or at a point perturbed along the normalized momentum (MoMuSAM, one gradient evaluation). The metric is accuracy on 400 held-out digits; diagnostics include train accuracy, the train-test gap, test loss, and a train-loss sharpness measure.

paper.title: Sharpness-Aware Muon: Matrix-Aware Optimization with Momentum-Guided Perturbations
paper.claim: Momentum-guided sharpness-aware perturbation (MoMuSAM) improves Muon's generalization at one gradient evaluation per step, matching or beating MuSAM, especially when minibatch gradients are noisy.

metric.name: test_acc
metric.description: Classification accuracy on 400 held-out load_digits samples after training (higher is better).

factors.name: method
factors.description: Optimizer: plain Muon (baseline), MoMuSAM (normalized-momentum perturbation, paper method), MuSAM (clean-gradient perturbation, costs an extra gradient per step).

factors.name: batch_size
factors.description: Minibatch size; smaller means noisier single-batch gradients.

factors.name: rho
factors.description: Frobenius-norm perturbation radius per parameter block (ignored by muon).

factors.name: train_n
factors.description: Number of training samples; small values give a data-limited regime prone to overfitting.
